en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a grand seafront palace complex situated on top of a high cliff above the sea. The large multi-storey building with a tower and flag stands to the right, with terraced gardens in front and a sparsely built coastline stretching to the left. Below the image there are captions in Cyrillic and French indicating the location and the building.
